purpose: Official-errata-first Core Force domain source definitions, typed checks/DCs, and modifier relationships; not runtime code.

sourceAuthority.book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

officialErrata.title: Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Errata and Official Clarifications
officialErrata.priority: Overrides first printed Core wherever conflicting

mechanicalPrinciples.rollType: Use the Force for Force Power activations unless printed rule explicitly substitutes an attack/opposed check.
mechanicalPrinciples.tierSelection: Highest qualifying DC floor, when the power actually has DC tiers. Do not invent tiers for opposed/defense powers.
powerRecovery: End of encounter after 1 minute of rest
Natural 20 Use the Force activation: regain all spent Force Powers at end of turn
Spend 1 FP as reaction to regain 1 spent Force Power
mechanicalPrinciples.modifierApplication: Resolve feat/talent/technique/secret effects by typed source identity, selector, event timing and precedence; not by labels, tags, or string matches.
mechanicalPrinciples.errataPriority: Official October 2008 errata > official clarifications > printed Core book. Later published supplements may introduce explicit modifiers, which do not silently alter the originating ability.
